comment: The two slits as run, the click experiment (the owner, 2026-09-30, 13:30, 'fringes are clicks, because a person sees them'; the advisor's design at the owner's word of 13:50, #1515 comment 5912573191; ALGEBRA.md row (g)): every number of the world, on the light-only universe file examples/events/light.json (rule.json with the holders of the content at the level weight 1,000,000, the advisor's LW for the light-only worlds, #1563 comment 5918198102, so that light's own well stays under one level), read by build_world.py, which writes the world file, its mode file (tools/pixel_mode.py, the message lay) and the blind expectation file per region. The flat board `length` x `height` x 1 (z folded), the packet of the light family at the wave `wave` (k = pi / 4, lambda = 8) laid over the column `packet.column` with the raised-cosine edge `packet.edge_along` along x, flat across the rows `packet.across` with the edge `packet.edge_across`, at the amplitude `amplitude` (10.00 quanta per Node of the plane record at the vacuum's paces; `laid` the count the engine lays at the paces of the vacuum content, from the run's books); the wall the inner face at `wall` with the two gaps `gaps` (d = 12); the screen the column `screen` (L = 24) declared as detectors of `rows_per_region` rows each, half the wavelength, the smallest region the law allows (No click names a Node), each opaque by the receding face `receding` beyond the screen, through which everything that passes the screen leaves the declared board and never returns; the bare region `aside` behind one gap, the rows and columns of a region against the wall, read beside the screen and taking no share (what arrives there); `ticks` intervals, the screen read in the window `window` (the packet's centre at the wall at about 18 and at the screen at about 62). The blind row: the advisor's per-Node row `blind_per_node` (#1515 comment 5903745976) summed per region, its total `blind_through`. The credit (the reading, tools/click_counts.py): each detector's share is its boundary's inflow (the `seen` lines) over the screen's total, N the total over W_c, the clicks credited N times the share and one draw by the shares with the seed `seed`, the instrument's; the exclusivity by the draw's construction.
